'''Reflections Booster Draft''' is a booster draft format played with [[Reflections]] packs. [[Decipher]] ran it as a sanctioned side event at [[DecipherCon 2000]] and listed a ''Reflections II Booster Draft Format'' among its tournament formats in 2001&ndash;2002; the [[Players Committee]]'s ''Alternate Format Tournament Guide'' (revised September 2015) keeps a Reflections Booster Draft with [[Reflections]], [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy|Reflections II]] or [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III]] boosters.<ref name="dcon-sw-events">[http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2000/events/starwarsccg.html Star Wars Customizable Card Game events], DecipherCon 2000, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010126213800/http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2000/events/starwarsccg.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="res-sw">[http://tournaments.decipher.com/resources-sw.asp Star Wars Customizable Card Game Tournament Resources], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20011116144130/http://tournaments.decipher.com/resources-sw.asp Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="afg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Star Wars CCG Alternate Format Tournament Guide] (revised 09/2015), Players Committee. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195355/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Type:''' booster draft
* '''Defined by:''' Decipher (2000); Players Committee (Alternate Format Tournament Guide, 2015)
* '''Card pool:''' DecipherCon 2000: 3 Reflections boosters and a Darth Vader or Luke Skywalker [[Enhanced Premiere]] pack per player. Players Committee: 4 Reflections, Reflections II or Reflections III boosters per player, plus up to six battleground locations brought by the player
* '''In use:''' 2000 &ndash; listed in 2015
* '''Also called:''' Reflections Sealed Booster Draft (Decipher's DecipherCon 2000 schedule);<ref name="dcon00-sched">[http://www2.decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swccgevents.pdf DecipherCon Master Tournament Schedule for Decipher Games], DecipherCon 2000, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030413152501/http://www2.decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swccgevents.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> Reflections II Booster Draft Format (Decipher, 2001);<ref name="res-sw" /> Reflections II Booster Draft and Reflections III Booster Draft (Players Committee)<ref name="afg" />
* '''GEMP:''' none. [[Reflections Sealed]] on play.swccg.com is a sealed (not drafted) Reflections league.

== Card pool ==
=== Decipher (2000) ===
"Players will be seated into groups of 4, with each player receiving 3 Star Wars Reflections boosters and either a Darth Vader or Luke Skywalker Enhanced Premiere pack to draft the best decks possible. Will you draft the foil, or let it go?"<ref name="dcon-sw-events" />

Decipher's ''Reflections II Booster Draft Format'' page was linked from its 2001 tournament resources, but every preserved capture of that page (reflections2.asp, 2002&ndash;2003) is an error page, so its rules are unknown.<ref name="res-sw" /><ref name="dec-ressw">[http://tournaments.decipher.com/resources-sw.asp Star Wars tournament resources], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020808154840/http://tournaments.decipher.com/resources-sw.asp Internet Archive].</ref>

=== Players Committee (2015) ===
The Alternate Format Tournament Guide requires 4 Reflections, Reflections II or Reflections III booster packs per player, played under its [[Booster Draft]] rules. "Each player may bring with them six battleground locations that may be included in the player's deck. The Tournament Director should verify these locations' status as battlegrounds prior to beginning the tournament."<ref name="afg" /> Under those rules players draft in groups of 4 or 6, Light and Dark seated alternately, and take one card of their own side from each pack and pass. The guide does not give a deck size for this format; deck building time is 10 minutes for 40-card decks and 20 minutes for 60-card decks.<ref name="afg" /> Its list of sealed formats names the format as '''Reflections II Booster Draft''' and '''Reflections III Booster Draft'''.<ref name="afg" />

== History ==
At DecipherCon 2000 Decipher scheduled the Reflections Booster Draft on Thursday 5 October at 6 p.m. (event #SW213) and Friday 6 October at 9 a.m. (event #SW221), four games each, entry $20, sanctioned.<ref name="dcon-sw-events" /><ref name="dcon00-sched" />

In 2001, and again in August 2002, Decipher's Star Wars tournament resources page linked a "Reflections II Booster Draft Format" among its format notes.<ref name="res-sw" /><ref name="dec-ressw" /> No event in the Players Committee format is recorded on this wiki.
